items.title: Sustainable Apparel Market, Global Market Analysis Report - 2036
items.content: Europe is a policy-led market for sustainable apparel. Textile waste rules and retailer take-back programs are pushing brands toward durable apparel planning. Certified basics and repair-ready clothing are gaining more attention across the region.
